name: WebsitePusher
author: WebsitePusher
description: Push your local WordPress changes to your live site safely. Automatic backups before every update, instant undo, and plain English controls built for non developers.
changelog: * Changes for the site owner's review: when someone other than the site's owner finishes, their changes are stored on the website, not put live, until the owner approves them in WebsitePusher (or sends them back). Approving puts them live exactly as a push would, with the same backups and undo.
